title: Cognitive Culture Lens v1 — Use Cases, Journey Maps and Product Surfaces
purpose: Extend the Cognitive Culture Lens from theory into operating surfaces, journey maps, product use cases, routing logic and commercialisable modules.

strategic_answer.what_it_is_for: A translation and governance layer for communicating across heterogeneous machine, SaaS, OT, consulting and organisational cultures. It prevents one instruction being naively treated as universal when every system hears it differently.
strategic_answer.why_it_matters: Enterprises are becoming multi-agent, multi-platform cognition fabrics. Without a translation layer, instructions fragment, systems optimise different truths, governance drifts, and operational coherence fails.
strategic_answer.category: Cognitive interoperability / organisational machine-culture routing / governed cognition control plane.

major_use_cases.name: Message Translation Across Systems
major_use_cases.description: Take one executive instruction and produce actor-specific instructions for LLMs, SaaS, OT, SI/consulting and internal teams.

example.aws_translation: Create telemetry, logs, traces, dashboards, alarms and uptime evidence.
example.mckinsey_translation: Define executive KPIs and operating model decision loops.
example.sap_translation: Standardise process visibility across master data and transactional flows.
example.palantir_translation: Fuse operational data into decision intelligence and mission context.
example.anthropic_translation: Define interpretable governance, evidence and alignment checks.

major_use_cases.name: Cognitive Routing Engine
major_use_cases.description: Route each task to the model, platform, agent or human role whose cognition best matches the work.
major_use_cases.example: Runtime telemetry validation routes to infrastructure cognition; governance policy routes to constitutional reasoning; market research routes to retrieval; pricing analysis routes to finance cognition.

major_use_cases.name: Procurement and Vendor Fit Assessment
major_use_cases.description: Score whether a SaaS, SI, consulting firm or AI vendor's culture matches the enterprise's operating need before purchase or integration.
major_use_cases.example: Avoid buying a flexible knowledge workspace when the need is deterministic evidence governance, or avoid using a strategy firm when the need is live operational telemetry.

major_use_cases.name: Prompt and Instruction Compiler
major_use_cases.description: Convert user intent into model-specific prompts and system-specific work orders based on actor culture and evidence requirements.
major_use_cases.example: Same intent becomes concise execution framing for ChatGPT, constitutional constraints for Claude, citation-first query for Perplexity, integration workflow for Copilot, and runtime primitives for AWS.

major_use_cases.name: Enterprise Cognitive Map
major_use_cases.description: Map all tools, agents, teams and vendors as cognitive actors with truth model, hidden fear, evidence standard, time horizon and authority edges.
major_use_cases.example: A portfolio dashboard showing which systems optimise for revenue, compliance, uptime, safety, engagement, knowledge, risk or decision superiority.

major_use_cases.name: Dr Dolittle Operating Console
major_use_cases.description: A translation cockpit where one message is previewed across many system cultures before dispatch.
major_use_cases.example: Type 'keep the system running' and see how AWS, Siemens, SAP, Claude, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Palantir and a human ops manager will interpret it.

major_use_cases.name: Failure Mode Predictor
major_use_cases.description: Predict where a message will fail because the receiver uses a different definition of truth, time horizon or risk model.
major_use_cases.example: Marketing asks for speed, compliance hears risk, OT hears safety exposure, finance hears cost leakage, engineering hears technical debt.

major_use_cases.name: Board and Executive Translation Layer
major_use_cases.description: Translate technical, AI and operational work into language board members, investors, auditors, operators and customers can each understand.
major_use_cases.example: One runtime initiative becomes investor value, auditor controls, engineer tasks, customer benefit and operator telemetry.

major_use_cases.name: Multi-Agent Governance Layer
major_use_cases.description: Assign autonomy tiers based on actor class, evidence requirements, risk and operational domain.
major_use_cases.example: Creative agent can propose; finance agent can reconcile but not pay; OT agent can alert and simulate but cannot alter physical control without gated policy.

major_use_cases.name: White-Label Cognitive Interoperability Product
major_use_cases.description: Package the lens as a product for consultants, enterprises and technology teams who need to understand how their tools and AI systems interpret work differently.
major_use_cases.example: A discovery workshop plus SaaS dashboard: map your stack, score cognitive fit, identify truth conflicts, generate routing and governance rules.

journey_maps.name: Executive Intent to Multi-System Execution
steps: Executive enters plain-language intent.
System classifies intent: strategy, governance, runtime, revenue, compliance, customer, safety or research.
Cognitive lens identifies affected actors and their truth models.
Instruction compiler generates actor-specific messages.
Risk and autonomy tier are assigned.
Messages are dispatched through approved channels.
Each actor returns evidence in its native form.
Truth layer normalises receipts into a single evidence ledger.
Coherence monitor flags divergence.
Operator sees: what was intended, what each system heard, what happened, and what proof exists.
journey_maps.example_output: One command becomes safe, actor-specific work orders with receipts rather than ambiguous human prose scattered across tools.

journey_maps.name: Tool Procurement Journey
steps: Business states operating need.
Lens identifies required truth model, time horizon, evidence standard and governance class.
Candidate tools are scored by cultural fit.
Mismatch risks are flagged before buying.
Implementation plan includes translation rules and evidence gates.
Post-deployment telemetry validates whether the tool behaves as expected.
journey_maps.example_output: Procurement shifts from feature comparison to cognitive and operational fit assessment.

journey_maps.name: AI Model Selection Journey
steps: User submits task.
Task is classified by evidence need, ambiguity, risk, creativity, governance and latency.
Lens scores ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Llama and specialist agents.
Router selects primary, reviewer and evidence-checking model.
Outputs are compared for divergence.
Final answer is composed with confidence and evidence class.
journey_maps.example_output: Model choice becomes governed routing, not habit or vibe.

journey_maps.name: OT / Safety-Critical Journey
steps: Operator submits operational concern.
System identifies whether the actor is IT, OT, safety, finance, compliance or executive.
Physical risk and authority boundaries are applied.
Instructions are translated into simulation, alerting, read-only analysis or gated execution.
No destructive or physical change occurs without policy unlock and receipt path.
Telemetry continuity and recovery state are checked.
Evidence is logged for audit and post-incident learning.
journey_maps.example_output: The lens prevents SaaS/AI-style ambiguity from leaking into safety-critical operational environments.

journey_maps.name: Consulting / SI Delivery Journey
steps: Client problem is decomposed into strategy, process, technology, risk, people and runtime components.
Lens identifies which consulting culture would naturally over-optimise or under-serve each component.
Delivery model assigns the right cognition to the right lane.
Executive story, technical build, governance proof and operational telemetry are kept aligned.
Progress is measured against receipts, not slideware.
journey_maps.example_output: Consulting becomes evidence-bound cognitive orchestration rather than disconnected advice and implementation.

product_surfaces.description: Canonical table of tools, models, vendors, teams and systems with culture, truth model, evidence standard and risk profile.
UI/API that turns one instruction into actor-specific language.
Scores candidate actors for a task using ontology fit, evidence need, risk, autonomy, time horizon and trust.
Shows how one message will be heard differently before sending it.
Highlights truth-model conflicts between systems, e.g. sales pipeline truth vs finance ledger truth vs runtime telemetry truth.
Converts native evidence from SaaS, AI, OT and human systems into standard receipts.
Produces role-specific journeys for executive, operator, engineer, auditor, customer and vendor.
Commercial consulting/product pack for mapping an organisation's cognitive stack and recommending governance/routing rules.

commercial_paths: Internal T4H control-plane capability for portfolio operations.
AI readiness and tool-fit assessment product.
Enterprise consulting diagnostic for SaaS/tool sprawl.
SI delivery governance layer for multi-vendor transformation.
Board-level AI governance product: explain what each machine culture hears and how evidence is proven.
OT/critical infrastructure AI safety translation product.
Prompt/compiler product that adapts messages per model/vendor/system.
Training program: cognitive interoperability for executives and operators.
acceptance_tests_to_add: Given one intent, generate at least five actor-specific translations.
Given a task, score at least five candidate actors and explain routing.
Given conflicting outputs, identify definition-of-truth mismatch.
Given a procurement option, score culture fit and risk mismatch.
Given an OT scenario, enforce read-only/simulation/gated action boundaries.
Given a consulting/SI engagement, map which firm/tool worldview will bias the outcome.
Given a portfolio stack, generate a cognitive conflict map.

next_build_recommendation.phase_3: Router: task-to-actor scoring and governance tier assignment.
next_build_recommendation.phase_4: Console: Dr Dolittle preview plus evidence requirements.
next_build_recommendation.phase_5: Receipts: proof that routed work happened and what each actor returned.
